{{Quote|Let me put a stop to your futile efforts!|The mercenary leader, before killing [[Essara Till/Legends|Essara Till]]|<ref name="SW:SF" />}}
A [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] [[Unidentified mercenary leader|leader]] flew a unique '''craft''' in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]].

==Characteristics==
The [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] [[Unidentified mercenary leader|leader's]] [[Starfighter/Legends|craft]] was equipped with [[Deflector shield/Legends|deflector shields]], communications systems, and a [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]]. The starfighter's armament consisted of [[Missile/Legends|missiles]].<ref name="SW:SF" />

==History==
The Trade Federation hired the mercenary leader and his craft<ref name="SW:SF" /> in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]]<ref name="The New Essential Chronology">''Star Wars: Starfighter'' refers to its events taking place during the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]]. ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' establishes that the invasion happens in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]].</ref> to [[Attempted kidnapping of Queen Amidala|kidnap]] the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo's]] [[Monarch of Naboo/Legends|Queen]], [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]]. Her escorts, flying [[N-1 starfighter/Legends|N-1 starfighters]], shot down the other mercenary starfighters at the site, allowing Amidala to escape. The mercenary leader appeared and shot down [[Essara Till/Legends|one of the pilots]] and damaged the starfighter of [[Rhys Dallows]].<ref name="SW:SF" />

The mercenary leader later appeared in his craft during the [[Battle of Naboo/Legends|final battle]] of the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]]. He launched his craft's missiles and [[Death/Legends|killed]] another Naboo [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]]. The other members of [[Bravo Squadron/Legends|Bravo Flight]] engaged the mercenary. The leader launched missiles at Dallows. Dallows survived their explosions, but while the [[Vuutun Palaa/Legends|''Vuutun Palaa'']]{{'s}} [[Hangar/Legends|hangar]] bay shields were down when the Control Ship launched a [[C-9979 landing craft/Legends|C-9979 landing craft]], the mercenary ducked into the port hangar. He was pursued inside by Dallows and they dueled inside the hangar. After their duel, the mercenary was forced to fall back deeper inside the Control Ship. Dallows continued his pursuit, and the mercenary flew through the power grid and into the innermost hangar. There, Dallows confronted him again. As they dueled, the mercenary complimented Dallows' skill, expressing regret about killing the talented Naboo pilot. Ultimately, Dallows proved to be the superior pilot, and the mercenary died when his craft exploded.<ref name="SW:SF" />

==Behind the scenes==
The mercenary leader's craft appears in the [[2001]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars: Starfighter (video game)|''Star Wars: Starfighter'']]. Its model was re-used for the ''[[Duergo]]'' in ''[[Star Wars: Jedi Starfighter]]''.
